docs.title: MSF Laravel Template
docs.text: This repository is the baseline Laravel app template for MSF-based projects. It includes a modern Laravel stack, GraphQL support, and a starter structure for building a management system or package-backed application.

docs.title: Project purpose
docs.text:
This project is intended to provide:

  • a clean Laravel application skeleton
  • GraphQL support via Lighthouse
  • local development convenience for app bootstrap
  • a reusable starting point for application-layer customizations

docs.title: Repository shape
docs.text:
laravel-template/
├── app/
├── bootstrap/
├── config/
├── database/
├── graphql/
├── public/
├── resources/
├── routes/
├── tests/
├── artisan
├── composer.json
├── docker-compose.yml
├── mkdocs.yml
├── .github/
└── openwiki/

docs.title: Stack highlights
docs.text:
The project includes:

  • Laravel 10 with app scaffolding
  • Lighthouse for GraphQL
  • Octane support for application runtime performance
  • Sanctum and related Laravel utilities
  • a starter app layout ready for feature work

docs.title: Local setup
docs.text:
composer install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
php artisan migrate
php artisan serve

docs.title: Operational guidance
docs.text:
• keep the app layer focused on the host project use case
  • use package-level concerns for shared logic when possible
  • document app-specific conventions in the project docs
  • extend this template carefully to avoid unnecessary framework drift

docs.title: Project overview
docs.text: The laravel-template repository is an opinionated starting point for Laravel projects within the MSF ecosystem. It contains the application shell and standard runtime configuration needed for a GraphQL-first Laravel implementation.

docs.title: Main responsibilities
docs.text:
This template is designed to cover:

  • app bootstrapping and environment configuration
  • Laravel application routing and service setup
  • GraphQL schema and Lighthouse integration
  • local development and runtime readiness

docs.title: Typical workflow
docs.text:
composer install
php artisan migrate
php artisan lighthouse:ide-helper
php artisan serve

docs.title: Development guidance
docs.text:
• keep the app-specific logic in the application layer
  • move reusable behavior into package repos when it is shared across apps
  • keep GraphQL schema organization clear and maintainable
  • prefer standard Laravel conventions unless the project specifically requires custom patterns
